$comment: The frames of the wire between cmux and the Chromium host app (behind browserHost.helper; plans/cmux-next/cef-helper-app-DESIGN.md, plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p05-ipc.md task p05-ipc-181).

Both codecs are built from this file at build time and are never in git (scripts/ci/generated-files.json): the Swift side by CmuxNextWireGen's HostWireEmitter through CmuxNextWireGenPlugin (ChromiumHostFrame, CmuxNextBrowser), the C++ side by cmux-tui/bindings/codegen/host_wire_cpp.py (chromium_host_wire.generated.h, which ChromiumHost/src/chromium_host_wire.h includes), as Chromium builds both ends of a mojom from one .mojom file.

header: the fixed little-endian header every frame starts with; fields are laid out in order, each at its natural alignment, and fill `size` bytes exactly. `role` kind is the frame's kind, `role` payload_length the byte count of the payload after the header. `count` makes a field an array.

max_payload: longer payloads end the connection (no kind carries more than a URL). constants: values both sides read off a frame's fields. kinds: every frame kind, with what its fields carry; `to_host` frames go from cmux to the host, `to_cmux` back.

golden: frames both sides encode and decode to the same bytes (ChromiumHostFrameTests, ChromiumHost/tests/chromium_host_wire_test.cpp). `hex` is the header; `payload` the UTF-8 text after it. A value over 2^53 is a "0x" string. The C++ generator checks each hex against the header fields before it writes anything.
Integer types: u8 u16 u32 u64 i8 i16 i32 i64. Names are lowerCamelCase: the Swift name as written, the C++ constant and kind names with a k prefix (wheelDeltaScale is kWheelDeltaScale).

fields.name: kind
doc: The frame's kind (Kind); a kind this side does not know still decodes.

fields.name: payload
doc: The payload's length in bytes.

fields.name: v
doc: Six values whose meaning depends on the kind.

fields.name: flags
doc: NSEvent.ModifierFlags for input kinds, more bits by kind.

fields.name: t0
doc: A time by kind: an input's event time (CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW nanoseconds, one clock for both processes).

fields.name: t1
doc: A time or id by kind: an input ring frame's control seq (high 32 bits) and page (low 32 bits).

fields.name: ch
doc: A key's character (UTF-16).

fields.name: unmod
doc: A key's character without modifiers (UTF-16).

fields.name: seq
doc: The input seq of an ordered input frame, or a request id (stats).

constants.name: quitLimitSeconds
doc: Seconds a host may take to end after quit or EOF before it is ended by force: the host _exits itself, cmux
SIGKILLs it. CEF's 3 s browser close plus Chromium's 10 s shutdown watchdog, with room for a loaded machine.

constants.name: wheelDeltaScale
doc: A wheel's v2 and v3 are NSEvent scrollingDeltaX/Y times this, rounded: hundredths.

constants.name: wheelPrecise
doc: A wheel's flags bit for hasPreciseScrollingDeltas. NSEvent.ModifierFlags never use it.

constants.name: readyReportsInputPresented
doc: In a ready frame's v2: the host sends an inputPresented frame for each input (its fork has the presentation
feedback callback).

constants.name: presentationVSync
doc: gfx::PresentationFeedback::kVSync (ui/gfx/presentation_feedback.h).

constants.name: presentationFailed
doc: gfx::PresentationFeedback::kFailure: the frame never reached the display.

constants.name: presentationHWClock
doc: gfx::PresentationFeedback::kHWClock.

constants.name: presentationHWCompletion
doc: gfx::PresentationFeedback::kHWCompletion.

kinds.name: navigate
doc: payload the URL.

kinds.name: geometry
doc: v0 width, v1 height (points), v2 screen x, v3 screen y (bottom left), v4 scale x 1000 (informational: the
host's window takes the scale of the screen it is placed on; cmux sends the geometry again when the window
moves or changes screen or scale).

kinds.name: mouse
doc: v0 x, v1 y (points, top left), v2 phase (0 move, 1 down, 2 up, 3 exit), v3 button (0 left, 1 middle,
2 right; ClickButtonOf), v4 click count, v5 pressed buttons (bits 1 left, 2 right, 4 middle, 8 back,
16 forward: NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons and the DOM's MouseEvent.buttons), flags NSEvent.ModifierFlags,
t0 event time. The back and forward buttons (NSEvent buttonNumber 3 and 4, Chrome's
WebPointerProperties::Button::kBack and kForward) are not sent until the host can click them
(p01-process-054b): CEF's SendMouseClickEvent has only left, middle, right.

kinds.name: wheel
doc: v0 x, v1 y (points, top left), v2 v3 scrollingDeltaX/Y x wheelDeltaScale, v4 phase, v5 momentum phase
(NSEvent.Phase bits), flags NSEvent.ModifierFlags | wheelPrecise, t0 event time (p04-input-063).

kinds.name: key
doc: v0 phase (0 down, 1 up, 2 flags changed), v1 key code, v2 repeat, flags, ch, unmod, t0; the host sends it
with cmux_shim::SendHostKeyEvent and the frame's input seq, which KEY_UNHANDLED carries back for a chord
the page leaves unhandled (p01-process-030). v3 (ChromiumHostTextInput.KeyMark, p01-process-043): on a
down, 0 the key and ch, 1 an input method took it (VKEY_PROCESSKEY down, skip_if_unhandled, no char), 2 the
char ch only; on an up, 1 the up of that process key (skip_if_unhandled).

kinds.name: focus
doc: v0 1 focused, 0 not.

kinds.name: ping
doc: t0 cmux's send time; the host answers pong.

kinds.name: stats
doc: seq a request id (never an input seq: not an ordered input kind); the host answers statsReply with the
same seq.

kinds.name: quit
doc: The host ends within quitLimitSeconds.

kinds.name: edit
doc: v0 0 copy, 1 cut, 2 paste, 3 select all, 4 undo, 5 redo.

kinds.name: ime
doc: One text input op of the page view's NSTextInputClient (ChromiumHostTextInputOp, p01-process-043), in
order with the key frames around it: v0 op (0 set composition, 1 commit text, 2 finish composing, 3 cancel
composition, 4 edit commands for the next key down, 5 an edit command with no key), v1 v2 the selection in
the text (op 0), v3 v4 the field range the text replaces (ops 0 and 1; -1 -1 none), v5 clause count (op 0);
payload the text as UTF-16LE (ops 4 and 5: the command names joined by '\n'), then per clause i32 start,
i32 end, u32 color 0xAARRGGBB, u32 thick (0 or 1). It has a payload, so it never rides the input ring.

kinds.name: textInputWatch
doc: v0 1: push textInputState after each change; 0: stop (p01-process-044).

kinds.name: gesture
doc: A trackpad gesture of the page view (p01-process-054), the input that RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost takes as
PinchEvent and SmartMagnifyEvent (content/common/render_widget_host_ns_view.mojom;
render_widget_host_view_cocoa.mm -magnifyWithEvent:, -smartMagnifyWithEvent:) and the Force Touch pressure
that -pressureChangeWithEvent: sends as a mouse event with force: v0 x, v1 y (points, top left), v2 type:
0 pinch begin, 1 pinch update (v3 the scale step x 1e6, 1 + NSEvent magnification), 2 pinch end (also a
cancelled pinch): PinchEvent's kGesturePinchBegin, Update and End; 3 smart magnify (a two-finger double
tap): SmartMagnifyEvent; 4 pressure (v3 NSEvent pressure x 1e6, 0 to 1e6, v4 stage 0 none, 1 click,
2 force click; Blink's WebPointerProperties::force); v5 pressed buttons as mouse's, flags
NSEvent.ModifierFlags, t0 event time. The host drops it until the fork can send it to the page
(p01-process-054b).

kinds.name: ready
doc: v0 fork API version, v1 host pid, v2 what the host reports (readyReportsInputPresented).

kinds.name: context
doc: v0 the CAContext id (bits of a uint32).

kinds.name: address
doc: payload the main frame's URL.

kinds.name: title
doc: payload the title.

kinds.name: pong
doc: t0 echoed, t1 the host's receive time.

kinds.name: statsReply
doc: seq of the request; v0 input events, v1 p50, v2 p95, v3 p99, v4 max (us from cmux's event time to the host's
Send*Event on its UI thread, over the last kHopWindow events), v5 frames refused (unknown kind), t1 input
frames coalesced into a waiting one (FrameQueue), t0 high 32 bits: times the host became active, low 32
bits: times one of its windows became key (each undone at once).

kinds.name: error
doc: payload the message.

kinds.name: rendererGone
doc: v0 cef_termination_status_t.

kinds.name: textInputState
doc: The focused field's text input state while watched (host_text_input.h's TextInputState, p01-process-044):
v0 ui::TextInputType, v1 flags, v2 v3 selection (-1 -1 unknown), v4 v5 composition (-1 -1 none); payload
i32 caret x, y, width, height, i32 text offset, i32 rect count, per composition character i32 x, y, width,
height (page-view points, top left), then the text around the selection as UTF-16LE.

kinds.name: inputPresented
doc: t0 the input frame's t0 (its event time), t1 when the frame that shows it reached the display, v0
gfx::PresentationFeedback flags (p04-input-066).

golden.name: key
golden.doc: A key frame with every header field set, signed values at both ends and a three-byte payload.

golden.name: wheel-gesture
golden.doc: A trackpad scroll's change (p04-input-063): precise, shift held, deltas -1.5 and 12.34.

golden.name: wheel-momentum
golden.doc: The same scroll's momentum start after the fingers lift: no gesture phase, a began momentum phase.

golden.name: input-presented
golden.doc: The input of event time 0x1122334455 showed in a vsync frame at 0x1122a0b0c0 (p04-input-066).
